title: stizolobium inflexum
intro: Stizolobium inflexum, commonly known as the "flexible pea", is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. The plant has been found to have various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Stizolobium inflexum include its potential to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
